meta.title: Turn Sieve (dsh-turn-sieve)
meta.description: Selectively drop whole Q&A exchanges or individual messages from the current conversation. Click “Sieve” beside any assistant reply to select it in place: that part gets a deeper background with rounded shadow corners, then confirm with ✓, cancel with ✕, and switch between “Exchange / Only this reply”. Once removed, the part disappears from the transcript immediately (the append-only log stays intact) and can be restored with one undo from the main panel. The main panel uses a liquid-glass look with “Liquid glass / Motion” toggles in its header. The system context, the initial session context and the latest exchange are protected.
